lastCompletedStory.title: Capture orchestrator session id in cam run + transcript path resolver

nextStoryContext: US-003 needs to wire orchestratorTranscriptPath into the dashboard or status renderer. The resolver is now available in src/transcript/usage.ts. Key callsite contract: caller resolves claudeDir as (process.env.CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR ?? join(os.homedir(), '.claude')) before passing to orchestratorTranscriptPath. The marker file lives at <cwd>/.claude/.cam-orch-session and is written fresh only on new sessions (not re-attach). parseTranscriptUsage + formatTokens are in the same module.

officialDocsValidated.summary: claude --help confirms '--session-id <uuid>  Use a specific session ID for the conversation'. Flag placement (after bypassPermissions, before the prompt) matches the implementation.
